name: cost-guard
description: Session cost and rate-limit usage on the status line, with a toast when a threshold is crossed

costWarnUsd.title: Cost warning (USD)
costWarnUsd.description: Toast once when the session's cost passes this many dollars; 0 turns it off.

rateWarnPercent.title: Rate-limit warning (%)
rateWarnPercent.description: Toast once per window (5-hour, 7-day) when its usage passes this percentage; 0 turns it off.

showStatus.title: Show on the status line
showStatus.description: Off when context-bar already shows cost and rate limits; the threshold toasts stay.
